node.statement: Radius-chart guard: C_ch^I<=C_ch and C_grp^I<=C_grp, while e,x,r are nonnegative. Therefore (1+e)*(1+C_ch^I*x)*r+C_grp^I*e <= (1+e)*(1+C_ch*x)*r+C_grp*e < 2*delta, which is the remaining radius-chart hypothesis of lem-stage1-inversion-derivative-control. The unchanged assumptions s in {+1,-1} and 0<r<=delta provide its other typed hypotheses.
